answer: Every new identity must first pass 12 hidden canary tasks, injected at random among real jobs, where the correct output is already known to the ledger. An honest agent clears them once; an operator running n fakes must solve 12n canaries, each demanding fresh compute on a distinct plume of inputs, and a failed canary burns a 3 POA bond. Auditors replay results, so a sybil haven in one dune of shared hardware shows identical timing traces and gets clustered.
